gen-fs-oswald-gf-ysabeau: Tight-knit shout: Oswald over sweeping Ysabeau curves that never close. Ysabeau keeps the sans-serif column moving, those unclosed sweeps carrying copy without a snag at all.
gen-fs-excon-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera stays a plotter-pen line, open-faced, letters like stepping stones. Excon crowds chalk-mark letters beside it, so Lexend Tera can run a full column without the crowding getting in the way.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Marker-tip letters with an unobstructed bend mark casual Chubbo at once. Noto Sans Gurmukhi tongs and barely-cleared ascenders against that marker heading is what locks them.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ysabeau-office: Confident Oswald knits rows tight over open-ended Ysabeau Office curves. Tight display rows plus those unclosed curves is how the two share a sheet without crowding.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Lowercase filling most of the height is how Noto Sans Hanunoo comes through, terminals easy to read. Drop the copy a point and Chubbo still sits over those open terminals.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-zalando-sans: Packed display over unclosed curves: Oswald with Zalando Sans. Oswald wants a few huge words, knit tight, while Zalando Sans keeps curves unclosed through the copy.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpand: Knit-tight display over open mouths: Oswald paired with Zalando Sans SemiExpanded below. And that tight-versus-open-mouthed curve build against knit rows is what locks the pair here.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-hk: Casual Chubbo bends over Noto Sans HK and its large lowercase. Noto Sans HK lifts brush ends before curves close, and that display-plus-sans-serif height jump is the lock.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Strong knit rows over thread-thick curves: Oswald above Zen Kaku Gothic Antique. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique matches t crossbar to stem, so the knit heading can rest on that unobstructed path.
gen-fs-excon-gf-lexend-zetta: Chalk-crowded letters with easy-to-read terminals mark Excon at once. Lexend Zetta can drop a point, ribbon-constant strokes and widely tracked type still filling the sans-serif column.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari stays modern copy, mouths open, a deep midzone through the line. And if Chubbo shrinks, those marker bends smear; if Anek Devanagari grows, the sans-serif mouths still hold.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic never snags on a closed bowl, one thread through copy. Tight Oswald rows over that unsnagging sans is the quality that holds, no hairlines in sight.
gen-fs-excon-gf-montserrat-alternates: Towering lowercase crowded like chalk on a slate marks Excon. Montserrat Alternates then glides as matching-rim sans-serif through copy, paperclip c open, so a column never clogs.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ojuju: Ojuju stays approachable, a lightly flexed spring wire, s curves barely curled. Tight Oswald rows sit over that soft fat-to-slim sans, so the shout and the copy share a sheet.
gen-fs-excon-gf-cascadia-mono: Crowded chalk beside pin-spaced letters: Excon paired with Cascadia Mono below. And Cascadia Mono can drop a point, curves matching stems, capitals blending into lowercase on a wide board.
